name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.222.0 — Prototype lane fixes from the walkthrough host: a behaviour-lane build no longer stops at red-check after the harden merge — --mark harden-merged records the merged HEAD as the pre-image, and red-check plus the stub-residue check judge the tree against it, so File Plan files the merge delivered are neither an impure pre-image nor stub residue; diff_base stays at the commit before the merge, so review and the commit reconcile still cover the merged data/API layer. prototype-driver reads a lettered brief id whole (04a-project-notes → 04a, not 04), so status.json, contract.json, the derived test file name, the prototype database name and the generated spec's brief no longer take the neighbouring brief's id, and the reserved spec name drops the letter with the number. 7.221.0 — Build capture gate joins prototype.url onto the relative route addresses the freeze writes in contract.json — a real frozen contract no longer dies on an invalid address at --mark captured; a relative address with no prototype.url declared is refused by name. 7.220.0 — Prototype lane fixes from the walkthrough host: --mark opened no longer checks the overlay import (the import lives on the prototype branch that opened creates), so a host without it on main no longer wedges as a stale branch — --mark round-done refuses until some file imports the overlay, records it as status.wiring, and the generated spec's File Plan drops that file when its diff is the import alone. An absolute brief path resolves instead of being joined under the root, and the Data/API sub-plan is written before harden/<stem> exists, so a failed write leaves no branch to wedge the rerun. proto-capture refuses when the page settles on a different path than requested (a signed-out login redirect was recorded as the route's baseline) and names a production build when fibers carry no _debugOwner. The overlay's queue bar and panel respect the safe-area inset, sit above host chrome, and flip to the top edge on tap.
